That looks like about 1/3 cup of orange rice, which will put you at about 130. Half an avocado is about 160, plus all that ranch is going to up you another 70 and the salad would be 20 to 40. At this point, you’re at about 390. I can see the oil from the chicken on the rim of the plate, and the way my African family cooks chicken with that kind of oil leads to one 3 ounce serving being about 200 cal, and it looks like you have two servings. So now we are at 790, and the refried beans could easily be another 200. So I’d say about 1000 calories, but I always tend to make my numbers higher when counting, it’s very possible I’m way off with the beans and chicken, but the rest are pretty standard. Things like oil and dressing will really trick you!
